subject: ANGL
title: English Language – Form 3
source: Syllabus scheme by module and week (no dates given; weeks placed in order through the year), 3 h/week

lessons.title: Discipline at school and at home: talk, read and write school/class/home rules; modals of obligation and advice; sounds /tʃ/ and /dʒ/
Dealing with teenage problems: listen, give opinions, write a magazine article; connectives of addition and purpose
Taking care of the family; meal times and table manners: adverbial phrases, collocations
Developing study skills: share study skills, letter on preparing for an exam, personal study timetable; adverbs of frequency
Club activities: talk, read and describe a school club; sounds /ʃ/ and /ʒ/; stress on compound words
Trades and professions: merits and demerits; comparative and superlative adjectives and adverbs
Growing and marketing cash crops in Cameroon: connectives of sequence; words related to agriculture
Effective time management: schedule of after-school activities; the simple future; idioms of time
Numbers and amounts; at the bank: telling the time, sums in figures and words, banking, job application, money order; active and passive voice
Means of transport: merits and demerits; prepositions of movement and direction
Living a healthy life style; sex education and preventing STIs: health tips, HIV/AIDS leaflets and slogans; imperatives; sounds /e/ and /ɜː/; abbreviations and acronyms
Urban and rural lifestyle, hobbies and interests: argumentative essay; review of sentence structures (SVO, SVC)
Waste management: strategies and posters; synonyms and antonyms
Natural disasters: narrative essay; first and second conditionals
Tourism in Cameroon: advertisement for a touristic site; third conditional
Volunteering and humanitarian activities; child trafficking: report writing; linking words of contrast; sounds /ʌ/ and /ɔː/
Tribal customs and cultural practices: the gerund and present participle; syllabification; word formation
Major historical events and personalities: describe a personality you admire; interjections; descriptive adjectives
Festivals and ceremonies: describe a festival you attended; modals for speculation; affixation
Arts and crafts: common artefacts and their uses; homophones; consonant clusters /kr/ and /br/
Using the telephone, computer and internet for study: expository essay; direct and reported questions; punctuation; sound /ə/
Using and managing the media for information and communication: argumentative essay; review of sentence types
Common professions related to science and technology: report or "dream job" writing; quantifiers
Scientific discoveries: article on a recent discovery or invention; indefinite pronouns
